notes.title: Small changes and bug checking
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Did some bug checks to make sure there are no bugs.
[*] Added some friendly soldiers to certain maps to support the player for better game balance.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed some of the achievements.
[*]Changed/fix some of the corrupted code due to an engine related error
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Changed resolution to not cause an error upon loading certain effects.
[*] Put in checks to make sure certain things are there
[/list]

notes.title: Resolution improvements
notes.content: Increased the default resolution. Press F4 for full screen.

notes.title: Bug fixes and changes
notes.content:
Everything changed:
[list]
[*]Changed how much stat increases when hanging out with a party member
[*]Fixed some text with a late game map notification popping up early
[*]Nerfed the sniper rifle to have a range of 5-30 tiles, but with a 40% hit chance
[*]Changed the level scaling slightly for enemies
[*]Small changes to the damage to location stability that is done with early game enemy groups when areas are left undefended
[*]Changed the decay amount each location gets per day from 5% to 7%.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes and gameplay changes
notes.content:
Here are all of the changes
[list]
[*] Made it more clear than F4 puts the game into full screen.
[*] Added more starting locations for each map, allowing more choice in planning where units will be.
[*] Buffed the Sniper Rifle to have unlimited range outside of 5 tiles near the user, but with a lower hit change (30%)
[*] Made it visually more clear where unit starting placements are.
[*] Changed some text to be clearer.
[*]Changed the stats to some enemy weapons to compensate for the Sniper Rifle buffs.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix and some smaller changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Pressing F4 will enter/exit Full Screen.
[*] Slight gameplay tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Whiteout Frontier has released!
notes.content:
In this SRPG, you will face enemies who are not only intelligent but also unpredictable, they are extremely dynamic in how they act for their survival at the cost of your own. If fought against when defending locations, they will get weaker, having less units and power for their future attacks. Eventually, an individual gang may become destroyed. But if left unchecked, they will get stronger. Locations will lose more and more resources until they fall apart into nothingness. With each day, you only have limited actions due to limited resources. They can choose to attack any location on the map they please, and the consequences of their actions will be felt throughout the game. Every choice you make matters fueling what and who is saved as the snow continues to fall. Some choices are small, but some will impact the rest of the story and how you survive. Will you be able to outsmart these criminals and survive? Only time will tell. 

In this game, there are two modes. Normal, which gives 30 days until a normal ending. This is a story focused mode, with many things tied to it. There is also an infinite mode, only for those who wish to see how long they can last against the horde of gangs. There are 4 game difficulties to cater to many different tastes, from easy to very hard, which changes how strong enemy gangs are to how powerful each attack is.

Develop Bonds with your crew. After every mission, there is time to talk to a crew member to understand them more. Every crew member has 11 ranks to progress with ranks that give them new abilities. Every rank increases the crew member’s stats and shows a piece of their story. 

There are 6 main endings in total, with many things made to make each map, each encounter, and every day fully dynamic and unique. No two playthroughs will be the same. There are many secrets to find and discover, making it great for playing it once, but very satisfying and rewarding with each new replay.
